title: StickZero
description:
I ported the Lua drone simulator StickTime to Rust for the CardputerZero which runs surprisingly well! I figured I should share the experience if anyone else is wanting to practice their flying with their CardputerZero. It should also work with goggles although I haven't tried yet. 
Mainly built around using a BetaFPV Air75 II & Meteor75 Pro II with Lava II 580mAh/680mAh batteries and a RadioMaster Pocket or EdgeTX radio controller over USB/Bluetooth. It has some realism built in like prop wash, battery sag, etc. that is all customizable to some degree. 
I also added sounds, an analog video filter, IMU sensor support, HDMI support and graphics settings.
Feel free to let me know if any issues, do a pull request or fork it on GitHub unless I might have already updated it!
